limitations: Actual GET_STATION command body under host ASan/UBSan with allocation/callback/serialization shims. Covers all interface enum values, netdev presence, required MAC, callback availability, each of 16 link allocations, message allocation, driver/serialization failure and MLO summary selection. Serialization shim follows actual ownership contract; netlink pre-dispatch, real station lookup, data serialization, driver lifetime/locking and runtime are not exercised.
